sources.name: Graphiti 021d3a5 OpenAIGenericClient
sources.supported_claim: constructor default max_tokens is 16384; json_schema and json_object modes exist; json_object explicitly injects the Pydantic schema
sources.unsupported_or_qualified_claim: json_object is explicit configuration, not an automatic switch after json_schema failure

sources.name: Graphiti 021d3a5 pinned README
sources.supported_claim: json_object is a documented local/OpenAI-compatible provider fallback
sources.unsupported_or_qualified_claim: main branch is not immutable evidence for the pinned experiment

sources.name: Qwen3-32B-FP8 model card
sources.supported_claim: non-thinking mode suggests temperature 0.7, top_p 0.8, top_k 20, min_p 0
sources.unsupported_or_qualified_claim: the card does not prove that sampling fixes the observed Graphiti truncation; 16384 comes from Graphiti, not Qwen's overall output-length advice

sources.name: vLLM 0.26.0 structured outputs
sources.supported_claim: backend auto makes opinionated release-dependent choices
sources.unsupported_or_qualified_claim: response_format json_schema alone does not identify the per-request selected backend

sources.name: vLLM 0.26.0 auto resolution
sources.supported_claim: v0.26.0 auto resolution tries xgrammar and can fall back to guidance or outlines
sources.unsupported_or_qualified_claim: configured auto is not observed request-selected backend evidence

sources.name: ContextPilot MLSys 2026
sources.supported_claim: baselines were tuned for performance and accuracy and aligned with their best reported configurations
sources.unsupported_or_qualified_claim: this is precedent for fair tuning, not proof that any MemBind threshold is universally correct

sources.name: Agentix NSDI 2026
sources.supported_claim: evaluation includes vLLM, vLLM-opt, MLFQ and Agentix plus program-level Poisson arrivals
sources.unsupported_or_qualified_claim: its baseline ladder is methodological precedent, not a directly interchangeable MemBind baseline

sources.name: Pie SOSP 2025
sources.supported_claim: systems share FlashInfer, reproduce common high-level workflows, use best-effort baseline optimization and report overhead
sources.unsupported_or_qualified_claim: Pie does not authorize method-specific compatibility changes

sources.name: Agent Memory arXiv 2606.06448v1
sources.supported_claim: public record identifies an arXiv preprint submitted 2026-06-04; paper content uses Qwen3-32B FP8, Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B and minimal interface adaptations
sources.unsupported_or_qualified_claim: public metadata does not independently establish an IISWC 2026 acceptance or to-appear status

sources.name: DistServe OSDI 2024
sources.supported_claim: when datasets lacked timestamps, evaluation synthesized Poisson arrivals at different request rates
sources.unsupported_or_qualified_claim: this supports a future load sweep, not its execution in the current pilot

sources.name: Parrot OSDI 2024
sources.supported_claim: end-to-end chain analysis includes client interaction and request re-entry effects
sources.unsupported_or_qualified_claim: MemBind's no-RTT-subtraction rule is a deployment and causal contract, not a universal rule established by Parrot

sources.name: OSDI 2026 Call for Artifacts
sources.supported_claim: artifact claims should be concrete and reproduction instructions, dependencies and limitations should be documented
sources.unsupported_or_qualified_claim: Artifacts Available evaluation is not itself proof of full result reproducibility

sources.name: NSDI 2026 Call for Artifacts
sources.supported_claim: artifact-paper claim alignment, clear setup and stable availability matter
sources.unsupported_or_qualified_claim: artifact guidance does not choose MemBind's experimental thresholds
